description: Exploit: spend the tip's margin on epochs. Start from tip E028 (commit 88b116f). First confirm in the code that it is the Muon line: Muon lr 0.24 / momentum 0.6 on block convs, fused into the graphed step, 128/256/704, first 50% of steps at 24 px with antialias, translate 2, LS 0.1, alternating flip, batch 2048, 9.5 ep, fused SGD+Lookahead on the rest. Change only the epoch count, from 9.5 to 8.75. Rescale the LR, Lookahead and Muon schedules to the new step count so they still anneal fully, keep the 24 px phase at the first 50% of steps, and recapture graphs in build if the step count is baked in. Report per-seed accuracy. If the 3-seed margin over 0.753 is under 0.3 pp, rerun once and pool before promoting (H1.1.3 rule). This also measures the Muon slope below 9.5 ep: E027 gave 0.29 pp/ep for 11 to 9.5.
